instruction: A polished gold wedding ring resting on the still surface of a circular decorative koi pond. The material is warm high-polish yellow gold with bright metallic reflections, floating on dark, glossy, semi-reflective water. Under the driving motion the ring settles onto the water surface, held up by surface tension, and slow concentric ripples radiate outward across the pond while the ring stays centered, its mirror reflection wobbling in the rings. Environment: a stone-rimmed garden koi pond with faint submerged pebbles and calm water, soft outdoor setting. Lighting: soft overcast daylight with gentle speculars on the gold and wet glinting highlights racing along each ripple crest. Camera: fixed elevated near-top-down three-quarter angle looking into the round pond, ~50mm, shallow depth of field. Color and mood: warm gold against cool dark water, serene, premium, tranquil. photorealistic, wet specular highlights, subsurface, shallow depth of field, high dynamic range, crisp fine detail, cinematic. --resolution 720p --duration 5 --ratio 16:9

Extreme macro close-up of two fingertips pressing down onto a soft foam earplug resting on a brushed stainless-steel prep table. The earplug is dense open-cell memory foam, matte with a faintly velvety porous skin in warm cream-orange. Under the driving motion the fingertips descend and squeeze it flat, the foam compressing and bulging outward into a squashed dome, then slowly springing back and recovering its rounded form as the fingers lift away. Environment: a clean industrial kitchen counter with soft out-of-focus steel reflections. Lighting: crisp directional key with gentle fill, bright specular glints on skin and metal. Camera: fixed low macro angle, ~100mm, locked framing, shallow depth of field. Color and mood: neutral steel grays with warm foam tones, clinical, tactile. photorealistic, wet specular highlights, subsurface, shallow depth of field, high dynamic range, crisp fine detail, cinematic. --resolution 720p --duration 5 --ratio 16:9

A rectangular bar of translucent glycerin soap standing at the center of a round studio podium. The material is glassy and honey-like, semi-transparent with a glossy skin, soft rounded edges and gentle internal light scatter. Under the driving motion the block clears from cloudy to optically transparent, then softens and slumps straight down, losing height as it flattens and spreads radially across the disc into a thin glistening pool, its surface settling into faint concentric rings. Environment: a clean minimal product-studio backdrop with a seamless neutral podium and soft floor reflection. Lighting: soft directional key with a bright rim, wet gleaming speculars raking across the molten base. Camera: fixed elevated three-quarter product angle, ~85mm, locked framing, shallow depth of field. Color and mood: warm honey-amber and pale-gold, clean, premium, appetizing. photorealistic, wet specular highlights, subsurface, shallow depth of field, high dynamic range, crisp fine detail, cinematic. --resolution 720p --duration 5 --ratio 16:9

A single pristine bead of water resting on a smooth, softly reflective tabletop. The droplet is crystal-clear and glassy, its taut skin pulled mirror-bright by surface tension into a near-perfect dome that refracts the room within its curved body. Under the driving motion the bead glides slowly across the surface from left toward right, and as it settles it relaxes and flattens, its rounded sphere easing into a low, wide dome clinging to the surface. Environment: a clean minimalist tabletop with a soft, out-of-focus neutral backdrop and a faint floor reflection. Lighting: soft directional window light with a bright crescent rim skimming the wet dome. Camera: fixed eye-level macro close-up, ~90mm, locked framing, shallow depth of field. Color and mood: cool clear water tones, silver-grey highlights, calm, delicate, precise. photorealistic, wet specular highlights, subsurface, shallow depth of field, high dynamic range, crisp fine detail, cinematic. --resolution 720p --duration 5 --ratio 16:9

A small mound of white powdered caffeine heaped inside a shallow round glass evaporating dish set on a low circular podium, viewed from a fixed elevated three-quarter angle. The powder is fine, matte and crystalline, faintly translucent at its edges with a soft dusty surface. Under the driving motion the mound stays centered and steadily dwindles in place, shrinking from a rounded dome to a tiny nub as a faint thin ribbon of vapor rises straight up from its crown and disperses, leaving delicate concentric rings settling on the dish. Environment: dim warm warehouse corner, softly blurred with a hint of a warming drawer. Lighting: strong low backlight so the drifting vapor glows against the shadow, gentle rim on the glass. Camera: fixed elevated three-quarter macro, ~90mm, locked framing. Color and mood: pale off-white and smoky amber, quiet, scientific, meditative. photorealistic, wet specular highlights, subsurface, shallow depth of field, high dynamic range, crisp fine detail, cinematic. --resolution 720p --duration 5 --ratio 16:9

A single heavy rubber ball above the center of a square trampoline pad. The ball is dense charcoal vulcanized rubber with a smooth glossy skin, faint micro-scuffs and a bright specular highlight; the pad is a taut dark elastic membrane stretched over a low square frame. Under the driving motion the ball plunges straight down, strikes the membrane and squashes into a broad flattened dome as the surface dips, then springs back and rebounds upward, re-rounding as it lifts clear. Environment: a clean minimal studio floor with a soft seamless neutral backdrop. Lighting: soft directional key with a crisp rim and wet gleaming speculars raking the taut surface. Camera: fixed elevated three-quarter angle, ~85mm, locked framing, shallow depth of field. Color and mood: charcoal and graphite grays, weighty, kinetic, tactile. photorealistic, wet specular highlights, subsurface, shallow depth of field, high dynamic range, crisp fine detail, cinematic. --resolution 720p --duration 5 --ratio 16:9

A tall brushed-aluminium stockpot standing dead-center on a wood-fired range, brimful of thick creamy coconut milk. The metal is scuffed satin with a soft highlight along its rim; the dense white liquid inside is opaque and glossy. Under the driving motion the pot holds its place and its surface simmers, a fine froth gathering and pale foam creeping slowly up the inner wall while faint steam curls off the top. Environment: a dim rustic cabin at night, dark timber walls and low glowing embers beneath. Lighting: warm firelight rising from below into deep ambient shadow. Camera: fixed slightly-elevated three-quarter angle, ~50mm, locked framing, shallow depth of field. Color and mood: warm amber lowlight against near-black, cozy, moody. photorealistic, wet specular highlights, subsurface, shallow depth of field, high dynamic range, crisp fine detail, cinematic. --resolution 720p --duration 5 --ratio 16:9

A knob of pale golden butter sitting at the center of a wide dark cast-iron skillet, product-style close-up. The butter is soft and creamy with a faintly glossy cut surface and rounded edges, its fat catching warm light. Under the driving motion the block softens and slumps straight down in place, losing height as it flattens and spreads into a thin sizzling pool, foaming at the edges and browning to nutty amber while faint concentric ripples ring outward across the melted surface. Environment: a heated skillet floor filling the frame with a shallow rim beyond. Lighting: warm directional key with a bright rim, wet gleaming speculars raking across the bubbling butter. Camera: fixed slightly elevated three-quarter angle with a slow subtle push-in, ~85mm, shallow depth of field. Color and mood: warm butter-gold and toasted amber, rich, appetizing, savory. photorealistic, wet specular highlights, subsurface, shallow depth of field, high dynamic range, crisp fine detail, cinematic. --resolution 720p --duration 5 --ratio 16:9
